stem:
The graph of f(x) = x^2 is shown on the grid.

Which statement about the relationship between the graph of f and the graph of g(x) = 7x^2 is true?

options.label: F
options.text: The graph of g is narrower than the graph of f.

options.label: G
options.text: The graph of g is wider than the graph of f.

options.label: H
options.text: The graph of g is 7 units below the graph of f.

options.label: J
options.text: The graph of g is 7 units above the graph of f.

visual_elements: graph of f(x) = x^2 on coordinate plane with x and y axes labeled and grid lines
